quality_statuses.research_candidate: The product fits an approved operator thesis and clears the lightweight research economics and product-character gates; production evidence is not complete.
quality_statuses.organic_sample_candidate: All organic-sample evidence, economics, fulfillment, inventory, and risk gates pass; physical sample is pending.
quality_statuses.organic_pilot_ready: All organic gates pass and the physical sample has passed operator review; paid acquisition is not authorized.
quality_statuses.paid_launch_ready: All paid-launch gates pass, including a passed sample and profitable numeric CAC estimate.
quality_statuses.rejected: One or more production gates failed; the product cannot be selected.

notes: retail_price_usd is the total customer-facing offer price; sub-$30 bundle components are allowed when a one-supplier bundle passes the offer-level gates.
Supplier margin claims are reconciled only when margin_basis is landed_cost; product-only or unknown-basis claims remain advisory.
Research and shortlist creation do not authorize ordering, publication, or external messages.
A product may not be marked organic_pilot_ready or paid_launch_ready until sample_status is passed.
Supplier identity, return policy, compliance/IP review, and quality evidence state are required production fields.
Unknown estimated CAC is allowed for research and organic sample selection; paid_launch_ready requires a numeric estimate that leaves at least 10% post-ad contribution.
The 45% gross-margin threshold applies only to organic sample tests and must also clear both 35% and $20 pre-ad contribution floors.
The 55% gross-margin threshold remains the paid-launch minimum.
Authorized branded resale is not excluded solely for being branded; counterfeit and unauthorized branded products remain prohibited.
Supplier-provided margin is advisory; WF-1000 recomputes economics from row-level costs.
